note: San Juan NF campground in ponderosa pine beside Haviland Lake, ~18 mi north of Durango off US 550 at ~8,000 ft, reached across the dam on FR 671. The lake is a CPW State Wildlife Area (wakeless: electric trolling motors or hand-powered boats only); using it needs a SWA pass or a fishing/hunting license. --Claude
